interpretation.no_additive_latency_claim: The 16 stages overlap and nest. Their durations must not be added into phase latency or subtracted to infer exclusive time.
interpretation.no_decode_or_sql_savings_claim: Exact decoder hits bind complete original input bytes but do not prove fewer SQL reads, fewer graph traversals or a timing gain. Decoder retained values are gauges, not monotone counters or RSS.
interpretation.no_cross_run_gain: F0 and campaign have different scopes and workloads; other commits, architectures, windows and later b811 observations are not paired controls.
